gaps: f_16c_block_50: the straight front and rear photos are a Block 30 and an F-16A of the same airframe; the rear shows an F100's nozzle, not the Block 50's F110 (from the three-quarter rear photo and the nozzle detail)
f_16c_block_50: the photographed stores vary sortie to sortie; the model carries tanks, AIM-120s and the Block 50 HTS and targeting pods as a typical fit

f_16c_block_50: dimensions 15.06 x 9.96 x 4.88 m from the USAF fact sheet as cited by https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Dynamics_F-16_Fighting_Falcon (49 ft 5 in x 32 ft 8 in x 16 ft). The CC0 three-view at one scale from its overall length gives a 4.0 m wheelbase and 9.51 m over the tip rails (9.96 m with the AIM-120s), but 5.19 m from wheel to fin top (Lockheed gives 5.09 m): the model presses its heights 4% into the 4.88 m frame
